items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: One was called Fetty Bones and Alpha Bones. Yeah. One was playing baritone and one was playing planet. Fetty was playing baritone and Alpha was playing planet.

ctx.x: They had some brothers down there. I can't think of their names and they all played music. Who that? Some brothers down there in Magnolia. I can't think of their names. Mm hmm. Harrison Bones told me about them. Let me see.

Harrison. Well, Harrison had three girls of himself. Yeah. One was called Fetty Bones and Alpha Bones. Yeah. One was playing baritone and one was playing planet. Fetty was playing baritone and Alpha was playing planet. and Alpha was playing Planet and Hassel was playing trumpet. Then he had another brother call him, oh he used to be the leader of that band, another brother, I can't think of his
name. Thomas Smallman. He had four brothers playing that band. Thomas, Thomas Bones.
